chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 87: Han Li Joins the Deathmatch with a Terrifying Display of Speed
chapter_meta_description: Han Li stuns the Seven Mysteries Sect by demonstrating lightning-fast movement, forcing Sect Leader Wang to accept him into the deadly blood fight against the Wild Wolf Gang.
og_title: A Mortal Shocks the Sect Leaders
og_description: In a bid to save his friend, Han Li drops his harmless facade and reveals a terrifyingly fast movement technique, instantly becoming the most dangerous variable in the coming battle.
twitter_title: Han Li: Healer? No, Speed Demon.
twitter_description: The awkward doctor just casually outpaced everyone's eyesight. The battle is officially on.
